priya: Quick Qtr OKR milecheck — brief async check: please post one-line under shipped / slipped / owner / next step. Need to close milestone decisions by EOD. @carlos @anya

carlos: Shipped: runtime v2 continuous-batching merged. Bench: ~20% avg latency drop on real workloads. PRs: github.com/rw/runtime/pull/412 :tada:

anya: Product note: Nice. Counts for KR-1 (throughput). Slipped: Dedicated autoscale alpha (was planned today) — infra tests failing. Owner: @leo. Next: decide canary threshold or fall back to manual scaling for next week.

leo: Owning autoscale. Blocker: perf tests flaky in staging when seq_len>1024. Created ticket INF-345. Quick log snippet:
```
staging-run -c config.yaml --seq 2048
[ERROR] kvcache overflow at step 912
```

jamal: I can help triage INF-345 tomorrow 9am PT. Quick Q: can we tag autoscale as a 'slip' (non-blocking KR) and move a canary to stretch if fix takes >72h?

priya: Proposal: mark autoscale slipped. Next steps: 1) triage INF-345 (leo/jamal), 2) ship short-term manual-scaling runbook (carlos), 3) postpone autoscale canary to next sprint. Owners: leo/carlos/anya. Can @deploy-bot post deploy notes after manual runbook?

deploy-bot: Manual-scaler v0.9 scheduled for prod deploy tomorrow 09:00 UTC if runbook is uploaded to /runbooks/manual-scaler.md :white_check_mark:

carlos: CR pings: two PRs blocking runbook: #789 (config defaults) and #790 (healthcheck). @anya can you review #789? It's tiny.

anya: Reviewing #789 now, will merge in ~2h. I'll also add rollback and monitoring checklist to the runbook.

priya: Thanks all. Final ask: any objections to updating OKR tracker to mark autoscale as 'slipped' for KR-2? If no objections by 5pm PT we'll update.

leo: No objections. I'll post INF-345 triage notes here after the morning run.

carlos: I'll draft the manual runbook tonight and ping for reviews first thing.

priya: Great — will update the tracker after 5pm if silent. :eyes:
